description: Use when configuring the Vite dev server, setting up proxy rules, enabling HTTPS, restricting file system access, or using middleware mode. Prevents exposing the dev server on the network without proper host/CORS settings and misconfiguring proxy rewrite rules. Covers server.host, server.port, server.proxy, server.cors, server.https, server.hmr, server.fs (strict/allow/deny), server.warmup, server.middlewareMode, server.open, server.headers, server.watch, server.forwardConsole, and server.allowedHosts. Keywords: vite, dev server, proxy, HTTPS, CORS, HMR, middleware mode, file system access.
